name: Economics Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/prices.json exists, parses, and its schema field is ai-architect.prices.v1
Every row in prices.json carries a non-empty source_url that resolves to a public vendor page
Every row carries a retrieved_at date that is no more than 90 days before the run date
Every figure in docs/architecture/04-roi.md is either a unit_price from prices.json or arithmetic over those prices, and the arithmetic is shown
A sensitivity band is stated on exactly the three drivers that move the total most, each with a low and a high value
The string IRR does not appear in 04-roi.md or prices.json
04-roi.md ends with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
notes: A number with no source URL and no retrieval date is not a price, it is a memory. Vendor prices move; a row older than 90 days is refetched or dropped.
